list: The official 55 trophies (1 platinum, 2 gold, 6 silver, 46 bronze; 28 hidden), names, descriptions and grades as published on PlayStation Network, via Exophase and PSNProfiles, cross-checked 18 Nov 2026 (planetgta6.com). All 55 are offline single-player trophies; there are no online trophies.

status_note: The game released in November 2026 and no verified missable list exists yet. Where a method is still unconfirmed by the community, the guide says so plainly instead of guessing. Counts (250 stunts, 42 shooting-range challenges, 14 drone-race locations, 18 meditation spots, 3 card sets of 18, 100 WAiNK scans, 50 of 80 challenges, 500 profile actions) are the cross-checked figures from GamesRadar+ / PowerPyx as reported by gamemapa.com and KeenGamer.

trophies.guide: The platinum pops automatically once the other 54 trophies are yours — there is nothing extra to do for it. Follow the roadmap in this guide in order: finish the story, clear the stranger strands, then work through activities, collectibles and the open-world checklists, saving the 100% completion cleanup for last. Push Square estimates the whole hunt at up to 300 hours, with the story alone taking around 60 hours, so treat it as a long project, not a weekend.
trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
sources: Official trophy list (PSN) via Exophase & PSNProfiles
Push Square — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap

trophies.guide: Play the opening mission, Gone Fishing, to the end. It is the first story mission, so this trophy is unmissable if you play the story at all — just follow the on-screen objectives until the mission-complete screen. No verified missable list exists yet for this game, so keep a manual save before big missions as a habit, but nothing in the official description suggests this one can be missed.
trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
sources: Official trophy list (PSN) via Exophase & PSNProfiles
Push Square — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap

trophies.guide: Finish every mission in Chapter 1. Chapter trophies unlock as the story advances, so keep playing the main missions in order and this one will pop at the chapter's end. If you spend hours on side content between missions, that is fine — story progress is what counts.
trophies.name: Paradise Lost
sources: Official trophy list (PSN) via Exophase & PSNProfiles
Push Square — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap

trophies.guide: Finish every mission in Chapter 2. Like the other chapter trophies it comes from story progress alone, so play the main missions through and it unlocks at the chapter close. The asterisks are in the official trophy name itself, exactly as PlayStation publishes it.
trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money
sources: Official trophy list (PSN) via Exophase & PSNProfiles
Push Square — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap

trophies.guide: Finish every mission in Chapter 3. By this point in the story new side strands open up — the stranger missions for Andy, Kenton and others — but the chapter trophy itself only needs the main missions done. You can leave the side strands for the cleanup phase after the story.
trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!
sources: Official trophy list (PSN) via Exophase & PSNProfiles
Push Square — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap

trophies.guide: Finish every mission in Chapter 4, the last full chapter before the finale. Keep a manual save as you approach the end of the chapter — no missable list is verified yet, and a save costs nothing. Once the chapter closes, only the final mission stands between you and the story's gold trophy.
trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma
sources: Official trophy list (PSN) via Exophase & PSNProfiles
Push Square — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap

trophies.guide: Complete the final story mission. Reviews put the story at around 60 hours, and once this trophy pops you can keep exploring Leonida freely — the game does not end your save, and Push Square notes a 100% completion checklist unlocks after the story to help with cleanup. Do the story first, then mop up everything else in free roam.
trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
sources: Official trophy list (PSN) via Exophase & PSNProfiles
Push Square — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap
planetgta6.com — story length ~60 hours per reviews
trophies.time: Story, ~60 hours to reach it (reviews via VGC / Push Square)

trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Breakfast Run. Mission trophies like this one unlock by finishing the named mission — play it through to the mission-complete screen. If a mission ever fails, retry it from the checkpoint; failing does not lock you out of its trophy.
trophies.name: Trust
sources: Official trophy list (PSN) via Exophase & PSNProfiles
Push Square — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap

trophies.guide: Complete the story mission The Cartel Heist, one of the game's big set-piece heists. Heist missions tend to be longer and harder than regular ones, so stock up on ammo and armour before starting, and use the checkpoints if a section goes wrong. The trophy is for finishing the mission, not for any particular approach.
trophies.name: Break the Bank
sources: Official trophy list (PSN) via Exophase & PSNProfiles
Push Square — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap

trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Child's Play. As with every named-mission trophy, the only requirement in the official description is finishing that mission — follow its objectives to the end and the trophy pops on completion.
trophies.name: Family Matters
sources: Official trophy list (PSN) via Exophase & PSNProfiles
Push Square — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap

trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Headliners. The trophy name (DWNFALL) is a stylised spelling from the official list — it is not a typo in this guide. Finish the mission and the trophy unlocks.
trophies.name: DWNFALL
sources: Official trophy list (PSN) via Exophase & PSNProfiles
Push Square — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap

trophies.guide: Complete the story mission VCIA Takedown, set around Vice City International Airport. Expect a combat-heavy mission — bring a good rifle, keep moving between cover, and let the mission's checkpoints carry you through the harder stretches. Finishing it is all the trophy asks.
trophies.name: Hi-Jacked
sources: Official trophy list (PSN) via Exophase & PSNProfiles
Push Square — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap

trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Operation Savage Glory. It is one of the later named missions, so it arrives after you have had plenty of practice with the game's combat and driving. Play it through to the end — the trophy is tied to completion, not to a score or a specific tactic.
trophies.name: Snow Storm
sources: Official trophy list (PSN) via Exophase & PSNProfiles
Push Square — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap

trophies.guide: Reach 100% completion on the in-game checklist, which Push Square says unlocks after you finish the story (under Progress / Stats). Rockstar has not published exactly what the 100% checklist covers, but the visible trophies map most of it: story, stranger strands, collectibles, activities and the open-world checklists. Work through this guide's roadmap stage by stage and check the in-game list after each stage — it is the only authoritative record of what is left.
trophies.name: A Long Road
sources: Official trophy list (PSN) via Exophase & PSNProfiles
Push Square — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap
KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

trophies.guide: Complete any 250 stunts across Leonida. The cross-checked community count is 397 stunts in total — jumps, under-bridge flights, knife flights and base jumps — so you only need about two-thirds of them. Stunts are tracked as you play, so many will happen naturally while driving and flying; for the rest, work through stunt jumps one area at a time and use the map to find ones you have not tried. A stunt counts once it is completed, not merely attempted.
trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
sources: Official trophy list (PSN) via Exophase & PSNProfiles
gamemapa.com — 397 stunts in total
KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Try each of the nine activity types at least once: fishing, hunting, golf, the shooting range, pool, basketball, a video game, a race and a stunt (gamemapa's cross-checked list). You do not need to be good at any of them — just start and finish one of each. Do this early, while you are learning the map, and it doubles as a tour of what Leonida offers.
trophies.name: Master of None
sources: Official trophy list (PSN) via Exophase & PSNProfiles
gamemapa.com — the 9 activity types

trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Earn a gold medal in all 42 Shooting Range challenges across the 12 shooting ranges (gamemapa's cross-checked figures). This is the skill test of the trophy list: learn each range's weapon and target pattern, take your time on the first runs to learn the layout, then chase gold once you know where the targets appear. If a challenge keeps beating you, leave it and come back after upgrading your aim with story practice — none of the ranges are missable.
trophies.name: The Shootist
sources: Official trophy list (PSN) via Exophase & PSNProfiles
gamemapa.com — 42 challenges, 12 ranges
KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun drone race at all 14 locations. Drone races are a separate activity from car races, so learn the drone's handling first — smooth lines beat jerky corrections, and cutting corners through gates saves more time than raw speed. Win one race at each location; the trophy tracks locations, not total wins, so move on as soon as a location is done.
trophies.name: Top Fun
sources: Official trophy list (PSN) via Exophase & PSNProfiles
KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

trophies.guide: Win 20 different races — different events, not the same race 20 times. Mix race types (street, off-road, boat and air where available) and spread them across the map so you also make progress on exploring Leonida. Upgrading your vehicle for the class you race in matters more than perfect driving, so spend a little of your laundered cash on a competitive car before grinding these.
trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
sources: Official trophy list (PSN) via Exophase & PSNProfiles
Push Square — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap

trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge. Fishing is one of the nine activity types, so this also feeds Master of None. Learn the fishing mini-game's rhythm first — steady reeling with the line tension in mind — then take on Cal's challenge. If you lose, you can retry the challenge; losing a fishing challenge does not lock anything out.
trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
sources: Official trophy list (PSN) via Exophase & PSNProfiles
Push Square — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap
trophies.time: Under 1 hour once fishing is learned

trophies.guide: Complete one arcade game — finish it, not just start it. Find an arcade machine in Leonida, pick a game, and play it through to its end screen. It is one of the quickest trophies on the list and counts toward trying the activity types for Master of None.
trophies.name: Stick Fiddler
sources: Official trophy list (PSN) via Exophase & PSNProfiles
Push Square — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Complete Andy's final mission. Andy's strand is one of the stranger mission chains: meet Andy, work through his missions in order, and the trophy pops on the last one. Gamemapa reports Andy's chain as 5 quests, Lucia only, from Chapter 3 — treat that as a community report, not an official fact. Stranger strands are hidden trophies, so keep the spoiler setting in mind if you are avoiding story details.
trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation
sources: Official trophy list (PSN) via Exophase & PSNProfiles
gamemapa.com — Andy's chain, community report

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Complete Kenton's final mission. Like the other stranger strands, Kenton's missions unlock as you meet him in the open world and play through his chain in order — the trophy is for the last mission, so there is no shortcut to it. Do the stranger strands after the story, when you can roam Leonida freely and pick them up one by one.
trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident
sources: Official trophy list (PSN) via Exophase & PSNProfiles
Push Square — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Complete Billy's final mission. Billy's strand is another stranger chain: find him in the open world, finish his missions in sequence, and the trophy unlocks on the final one. If a stranger does not appear, advance the story a little — stranger missions often unlock at certain story points.
trophies.name: The Lone Rider
sources: Official trophy list (PSN) via Exophase & PSNProfiles
Push Square — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap

trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Complete 8 stranger mission strands across Leonida. This is the umbrella trophy for the side characters: Andy, Kenton, Billy, Randy, Tyrone and Bret each have a strand, plus other strangers scattered around the state. Finish any 8 full strands — the individual final-mission trophies count toward it. Check your progress in the game's stats and mop up the strands you have not started after the story.
trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
sources: Official trophy list (PSN) via Exophase & PSNProfiles
Push Square — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Complete Randy's final mission. Randy's strand is one of the stranger chains counted toward Strangers & Freaks, so finishing it moves two trophies at once. Work through his missions in order in free roam after the story, when every stranger location is open to you.
trophies.name: Supply & Demand
sources: Official trophy list (PSN) via Exophase & PSNProfiles
Push Square — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Complete Tyrone's final mission. Tyrone's chain is another stranger strand: meet him, play his missions in order, and the trophy pops on the last one. If you are hunting the platinum, clear all five named stranger strands plus three more to also earn Strangers & Freaks.
trophies.name: Spin On This!
sources: Official trophy list (PSN) via Exophase & PSNProfiles
Push Square — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap

trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: Meditate at all 18 meditation spots across Leonida (gamemapa's cross-checked count). Meditation spots are a collectible-style checklist: visit each one and meditate there. Warning — gamemapa reports that one meditation spot is missable, so do not leave this for the very end: start visiting spots as you explore, and keep a manual save before story beats that change the world. That missable claim is a community report, not confirmed by Rockstar, and this guide flags it rather than stating it as fact.
trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
sources: Official trophy list (PSN) via Exophase & PSNProfiles
gamemapa.com — 18 spots, one reported missable

trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Hunt a unique animal for Bret. Bret's strand involves hunting, so bring a rifle with a scope and track the animal patiently — unique animals are usually found in one specific area, and the hunt is the point, not a quick kill. This is a hidden trophy, so the official description gives no location; community hunting guides will name the animal and its area once they are verified, and this guide will not guess at either.
trophies.name: Fair Game
sources: Official trophy list (PSN) via Exophase & PSNProfiles
Push Square — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap

trophies.guide: Complete 3 collectible card sets. There are 18 card sets in total (gamemapa's cross-checked count), so you only need three — pick the sets whose cards cluster in areas you already visit and finish those first. Cards are scattered across Leonida, so collect them as you explore rather than hunting all of them in one sweep; a card checklist or map from a community guide helps, but check it against your in-game count.
trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck
sources: Official trophy list (PSN) via Exophase & PSNProfiles
gamemapa.com — 18 card sets

trophies.guide: Use the WAiNK app to scan 100 locations across Leonida — landmarks, curiosities and sculptures (gamemapa). WAiNK scanning is the game's photo/scan collectible: open the app at a point of interest and scan it. Scan everything you pass while doing other things and the count climbs on its own; for the last few, sweep the map region by region. A scan also counts toward discovering vehicles for Whip It Good, so combine the two.
trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
sources: Official trophy list (PSN) via Exophase & PSNProfiles
gamemapa.com — landmarks, curiosities, sculptures

trophies.guide: Complete 50 of the 80 challenges (gamemapa's cross-checked count). Challenges are small objectives spread across activities — stunts, races, combat, exploration — so this trophy advances while you chase the others. Check the challenge list in the game regularly and pick off the easy ones you have not done; you need 50 of 80, so the hardest ones can be skipped.
trophies.name: One Last Thing
sources: Official trophy list (PSN) via Exophase & PSNProfiles
gamemapa.com — 50 of 80 challenges

trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: With your partner alongside you, build up a 4-star wanted level, then lose the cops and escape. Do it away from tight city streets if you can — open roads and the countryside give you room to break line of sight, and a fast car with good handling helps more than a fast car with bad brakes. Your partner must be with you when the wanted level drops, so do not let them get separated during the chase.
trophies.name: Hot Together
sources: Official trophy list (PSN) via Exophase & PSNProfiles
Push Square — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap

trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: With your partner, rob 3 shops back-to-back without losing your wanted level — meaning you must keep the heat on through all three robberies, not escape between them. Plan a route of three close shops, hit them fast, and keep a getaway car parked nearby for the escape afterwards. This is one of the trickier partner trophies, so expect a few attempts; a failed run costs nothing but time.
trophies.name: Retail Therapy
sources: Official trophy list (PSN) via Exophase & PSNProfiles
Push Square — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap

trophies.guide: Discover 100 vehicles across Leonida. A WAiNK scan of a vehicle is enough to count it (gamemapa), so scan every new vehicle you see while exploring — parked cars, boats, aircraft and the oddities count too. This climbs naturally alongside You WAiNKer! and The Goodtime State, so do not grind it alone: just scan as you go.
trophies.name: Whip It Good
sources: Official trophy list (PSN) via Exophase & PSNProfiles
gamemapa.com — a WAiNK scan counts

trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus. Combat Focus is the game's slow-down aiming mode — trigger it when a group of enemies is bunched up, then work through them quickly while time is slowed. Pick a busy fight with weak enemies rather than a boss encounter, and use a weapon with a fast fire rate so you can drop five before the focus ends.
trophies.name: Gunslinger
sources: Official trophy list (PSN) via Exophase & PSNProfiles
Push Square — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap

trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Make an unscheduled departure at Vice City International Airport — in plain terms, steal a plane (or otherwise take off) from VCIA without a ticket or a flight plan. Get onto the airfield, grab an aircraft and take off. Expect a wanted level, so be ready to fly away fast once you are airborne. This is a hidden trophy, so the official description is deliberately vague, but the airport setting makes the intent clear.
trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
sources: Official trophy list (PSN) via Exophase & PSNProfiles
Push Square — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap

trophies.guide: This hidden trophy's description is a joke about Rhino tanks, and its exact unlock is still unconfirmed — no verified community method exists yet. The sensible reading is that it involves the Rhino tank: finding one, driving one, or surviving an encounter with one. Do not chase this blindly; check a verified community guide once one exists, and this guide flags the trophy as unconfirmed rather than inventing steps for it.
trophies.name: Challenging Tank
sources: Official trophy list (PSN) via Exophase & PSNProfiles
gamemapa.com — listed among unsolved hidden trophies

trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Rob a jewelry store without being detected — a stealth robbery, not a smash-and-grab. Case the store first, plan your entry, keep quiet, and leave before anyone raises the alarm. If you are spotted, the attempt fails, so restart rather than fighting your way out. Stealth gear and patience matter more than firepower here.
trophies.name: Sneakthief
sources: Official trophy list (PSN) via Exophase & PSNProfiles
Push Square — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap

trophies.guide: Rob 5 bank vaults and escape after each one. Bank vault robberies are the big open-world heists: plan the approach, crack the vault, grab the cash and get away clean — escaping is part of the trophy, not optional. Do them one at a time and let the heat die down between attempts; five clean escapes earn the silver.
trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
sources: Official trophy list (PSN) via Exophase & PSNProfiles
Push Square — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap

trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Rob an armored truck and escape. Armored trucks roam Leonida's roads — spot one, stop it, crack it open and take the cash, then lose the wanted level that follows. A good ambush spot is a quiet stretch of road where you can block the truck and work fast. Escaping after the robbery is part of the trophy, so have a getaway car ready.
trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
sources: Official trophy list (PSN) via Exophase & PSNProfiles
Push Square — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap

trophies.guide: Explore every area of Leonida. The cross-checked community figure is 52 areas to visit (gamemapa's report, via the official description's explore-everywhere wording). Drive, fly and sail through each region — the map fills in as you go, and the trophy pops when the last area registers. Combine this with WAiNK scanning, vehicle discovery and meditation spots so one sweep of the map feeds four trophies at once.
trophies.name: The Goodtime State
sources: Official trophy list (PSN) via Exophase & PSNProfiles
gamemapa.com — 52 areas, community report

trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob one illegal operation belonging to each of the 9 gangs (gamemapa's cross-checked count). Illegal operations are gang-run spots around the map — hit one per gang and the trophy pops. Gangs will not like it, so expect resistance and a wanted level; go in prepared and get out fast. A community map of gang territories helps you find the last one or two.
trophies.name: Pest Control
sources: Official trophy list (PSN) via Exophase & PSNProfiles
gamemapa.com — 9 gangs

trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach. This hidden trophy is a quiet moment, not a mission: go to Ocean Beach, find a bar or spot with a view, and order a cocktail. The exact trigger is still unconfirmed by the community — the description names the beach, not the bar — so if it does not pop at the first likely spot, try other beachfront bars. No location is asserted here because none is verified yet.
trophies.name: In The Beginning…
sources: Official trophy list (PSN) via Exophase & PSNProfiles
gamemapa.com — listed among unsolved hidden trophies

trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style — a nod to the series' famous opening moments. Drive a car through the showroom's glass front and out onto the street. The exact showroom is still unconfirmed, so try the most prominent vehicle showroom you find; the trophy should pop the moment you break out. Do not buy the car first — the point is the exit, not the purchase.
trophies.name: Capital Offense
sources: Official trophy list (PSN) via Exophase & PSNProfiles
gamemapa.com — listed among unsolved hidden trophies

trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Follow through at the Kolt & Associates bowling alley — play a game of bowling there. Bowling is one of the pastime activities, so a full game at this specific alley should pop the trophy on completion. The alley's name is in the official description, so this one names its own location; if the trophy does not pop after one game, finish the game properly rather than quitting early.
trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling
sources: Official trophy list (PSN) via Exophase & PSNProfiles
Push Square — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap

trophies.guide: This hidden trophy's description is deliberately vague — a partnership with mass appeal — and its unlock is still unconfirmed. The likely reading is a moment where you and your partner do something that draws a crowd or goes public, but no verified method exists yet. This guide will not invent steps for it: check a verified community guide once the method is confirmed, and tick it off then.
trophies.name: Personal Best
sources: Official trophy list (PSN) via Exophase & PSNProfiles
gamemapa.com — listed among unsolved hidden trophies

trophies.guide: Make choices that affect your Criminal Profile — gamemapa's cross-checked figure is 500 actions that affect it. This is a cumulative counter, not a single decision: every choice you make in missions and the open world that shifts your profile adds up. Play normally, make decisions rather than avoiding them, and check your profile counter in the game's stats to see how close you are.
trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
sources: Official trophy list (PSN) via Exophase & PSNProfiles
gamemapa.com — 500 actions, community report

trophies.guide: The description — second time's the charm — suggests succeeding at something on your second attempt after failing once, but the exact trigger is still unconfirmed. The most sensible reading is to retry something you failed and succeed: a failed mission, race or challenge, completed on the second try. Do not force it; it will likely pop naturally while you play, and this guide flags it as unconfirmed rather than guessing the trigger.
trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
sources: Official trophy list (PSN) via Exophase & PSNProfiles
gamemapa.com — listed among unsolved hidden trophies

trophies.guide: This hidden trophy is tied to something strange — an event, easter egg or random encounter — and its method is still unconfirmed. Gamemapa lists it among the five still-unsolved hidden trophies. The honest advice is to explore widely, investigate odd happenings instead of driving past them, and watch for verified community reports once players pin the trigger down. No location or event is asserted here because none is verified.
trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
sources: Official trophy list (PSN) via Exophase & PSNProfiles
gamemapa.com — one of five unsolved hidden trophies

trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: Knock someone over with a melee drive-by — a melee attack from a moving vehicle. The precise method is still being confirmed by the community (KeenGamer), but the shape of it is clear: be a passenger or driver, swing a melee weapon at a pedestrian as you pass, and connect. Pick a slow vehicle and a quiet street so you can line the hit up, and expect a few attempts before it lands.
trophies.name: Ten Pin
sources: Official trophy list (PSN) via Exophase & PSNProfiles
KeenGamer — precise method still being confirmed

trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Earn $250,000 by laundering Marked Bills through your contacts. Marked Bills are dirty money from robberies and heists — clean them through your contacts in batches, and the counter climbs with each laundered dollar. Do your bank vaults, armored trucks and shop robberies first so you have bills to launder, and keep laundering as you go rather than saving it all for the end.
trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
sources: Official trophy list (PSN) via Exophase & PSNProfiles
Push Square — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap
trophies.time: Across the game, tied to robberies

trophies.guide: Spend $100,000 across all shops in Leonida. This is a cumulative spend counter — clothes, food, ammo, vehicle upgrades and property extras all count. It will climb on its own as you gear up for races and robberies; if you are close at the end, spend the remainder on vehicle upgrades, which are useful anyway. Do not waste money early just to rush it — the cash is better spent on the cars and gear the harder trophies need.
trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
sources: Official trophy list (PSN) via Exophase & PSNProfiles

trophies.guide: Purchase all 8 garage properties (gamemapa's cross-checked count). Garages are bought with clean money, so launder your Marked Bills first and save for them deliberately — they are also useful, since they store the vehicles you discover for Whip It Good. Check the property listings as you explore and buy each garage when you can afford it; the trophy pops on the last purchase.

trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app. The app is the in-game way to log vehicles you find — register each new vehicle you discover and the count climbs alongside Whip It Good's 100 discoveries. You only need 10 registered, so this one finishes long before the vehicle hunt does. Keep the app open while exploring so registering becomes a habit.
